title: Garlicky Corn Pilaf
description: A flavorful and aromatic side dish, perfect for any meal. This garlicky corn pilaf combines the sweetness of corn with the savory taste of garlic and the crunch of pilaf.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the corn kernels and cook for 3-4 minutes until tender.
Stir in the pilaf and cook for 1-2 minutes until lightly toasted.
Squeeze the lemon juice over the pilaf and season with salt and pepper to taste.
